description: HubSpot is a CRM and marketing/sales/service platform with a REST API for reading and writing contacts, deals, companies, tickets, and marketing objects.
access_notes: Free developer/sandbox accounts (e.g. the free CMS developer sandbox) are self-serve and let you build and test immediately. Conditional gate: the scopes and rate limits an integration actually gets against a real customer's portal depend on that portal's paid HubSpot subscription tier -- building/testing is free, but some functionality requires the target account to be on a paid plan.
api_notes: Covers CRM objects (contacts, companies, deals, tickets), marketing (email, forms, workflows), and CMS -- one of the widest object models in the CRM category.
